_doc: Deployable Shield (defender pool; research/gadgets.md §4.2). One each; set on the floor as waist-high cover, picked up again while its glass is clear. How long it takes to set up, its reach and its size are placeholders. It's solid (M3): bulletproof, slits included, it stops bodies, drones, throws and blasts (any blast close by destroys it); attackers vault it. A knife hit makes its glass opaque, and then it can't be picked up (Fandom).
name: Deployable Shield
